arguments.value: This agreement says TransMontaigne Management Company will provide management, operational, and administrative services to TLP Management Services and its affiliates using its employees, and TLP will reimburse all related direct and indirect costs such as salaries, benefits, taxes, severance, and employee-related claims. TLP must also pay an extra fee equal to 1% of the reimbursed amount. The parties can settle payments through their usual intercompany process. The agreement is governed by Colorado law, can be ended by either party on 5 days’ written notice or by mutual written agreement, and can only be changed in writing. It also includes standard terms about jurisdiction in Colorado, assignment limits, severability, and execution in counterparts.
